Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The National Assembly may, with support of at least one third of its members, motion of no confidence in the Government. If the vote passes with at least two-thirds support, the King must dismiss the Government.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society

Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Auditor General submits an annual report to the King, the Prime Minister and Parliament.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society

Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Commission is charged with training, placing, and promoting quality civil servants within a transparent and accountable apparatus. It also provides that the Commission must operate under the Civil Service Act of Parliament.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Constitution also codifies and explains the function of the Anti-_____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Constitution also codifies and explains the function of the Anti-Corruption Commission.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
